m7g.currentLimitation: Dashboard can read/upload/reset the local JSON matrix, switch moods dynamically, expose and persist concrete JSON XTTS/delivery values, map generic prosody sliders into concrete XTTS params, pass active XTTS params to the current single-utterance local XTTS request, and precompute per-chunk prosody sheet metadata. XTTS still receives canonical text as one request in the current path; true pitch shifting, timbre shaping, chunk-by-chunk synthesis, mid-speech parameter changes, pause insertion, and FFmpeg audio post-processing remain M7H/M7I work.

m7h.currentLimitation: Current XTTS runtime remains one request per assistant turn; M7H now computes an utterance-level effective XTTS envelope from per-chunk scores. Full chunk-by-chunk synthesis, rest insertion, stitching, and per-chunk audio artifacts remain M7I. FFmpeg/DSP post-processing remains an optional later M7H polish lane.

r2FinalWavBargeInFix.finding: Manual playback of the final WAV fallback was not stopped by mic-start because only the streaming chunk Audio object was tracked as active playback.
r2FinalWavBargeInFix.fix: Registered inline final WAV audio elements by turnId and made stopActivePlayback pause/reset any registered or currently-playing audio element while preserving final WAV replay/save ability.

r3StreamingMicLifecycleConfirmation.finding: After live streaming playback cut out on mic-start, the mic continued recording with no break and no browser error.

m7p.currentLimitation: M7P verified live browser playback and mic-start interruption. It did not verify non-blank spoken interruption recognition or true low-latency streaming while synthesis is still running.

integration.rawPreservation: raw XTTS chunk artifacts and DSP intermediates remain on disk under local output dir

r2TruncationFix.finding: Initial M5.6 sounded better but produced about 0:02 and cut off mid-sentence.
r2TruncationFix.rootCause: FFmpeg silenceremove stop_periods=1 can treat normal phrase pauses as end-of-audio.
r2TruncationFix.fix: Removed end/tail trimming and kept only conservative leading-silence trim.
r2TruncationFix.regressionGate: M5.6 filter must not contain stop_periods=

r3TailGuardFix.finding: R2 timing was much better but final syllable clipped slightly at the end of the full sentence.
r3TailGuardFix.fix: Added 320 ms apad tail guard after mastering while keeping end/tail trimming disabled.
r3TailGuardFix.regressionGate: M5.6 filter includes apad=pad_dur=0.320 and does not contain stop_periods=

r4TerminalTailDrainFix.finding: R3 preserved voice body but still cut the final syllable in half abruptly.
r4TerminalTailDrainFix.fix: Increased post-mastering apad tail guard to 900 ms and added a TTS-only terminal render hint for the final chunk while preserving canonical text/hash.
r4TerminalTailDrainFix.regressionGate: M5.6 filter includes apad=pad_dur=0.900, final chunk applies terminalTailHintApplied=true, and canonical text remains unchanged.

m56.currentLimitation: M5.6 R4 passed live browser tail/drain confirmation. Remaining voice work before production closeout includes live-driven prosody/mood scoring and audio-first multiplexed streaming architecture.

m7q.summary: Browser MediaRecorder partial slices now post accumulated local audio to /api/stt/partial-audio, which normalizes/transcribes through configured local STT and returns sanitized partial duplex summaries.

liveEvidence.screenshotEvidence: Partial STT seq 0-5 progressively expanded transcript; final Mic transcript populated input; privacy guard showed raw mic transcript durable storage is off.

m7r.summary: Realtime frame manifests now expose an explicit low-latency transport plan, and the browser uses a preloaded serial audio queue with client-side first-play/inter-chunk-gap telemetry.
